products.title: Royal Amber Oud
products.description:
A majestic blend of rich Cambodian Oud, warm amber resin, and velvety royal roses. Formulated with high-concentration EDP oils for 14+ hours of intense sillage.

✨ **Fragrance Architecture**:
- 🌿 **Top Notes**: Fresh Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Wild Lavender
- 🌸 **Heart Notes**: Royal Jasmine, Taif Rose, Warm Cinnamon
- 🪵 **Base Notes**: Aged Agarwood (Oud), Ambergris, Creamy Vanilla & Cashmere Musk

📊 **Performance & Characteristics**:
- ⏳ **Longevity**: 14+ Hours Long Lasting EDP
- 🌬️ **Projection**: Heavy Sillage (Room Filling)
- 👔 **Best For**: Evening Wear, Weddings, Formal Gatherings & Special Occasions
- 💧 **Volume**: 100ml Eau de Parfum (Pure High Concentration Oil)
